blockers.verbatim_goal: For qnf : NormalForm sig k 3, express exists y, nf_eval_nf M k 3 (Fin.cons y (Fin.cons x (fun _ => t))) qnf as a nested Since/Until bracket splitting y by zone, with depth-k IH formulas (exist_tl_fn_k and its neg) as the bracket point/segment TemporalPred types.
blockers.root_cause: At depth k+1, nf_eval_nf's quant layer qnf.2 : NormalForm sig k 4 -> Bool has semantics: forall sub, (exists w, nf_eval_nf M k 4 (Fin.cons w [y,x,t]) sub) <-> (qnf.2 sub = true). This couples y,x,t simultaneously through the shared quantified w and does NOT factor through per-variable projections. The naive projection-based VecEA2 (endpoint/witness = per-variable characteristic formulas glued by order atoms via reconstruct_nf_3var, the depth-0 template) satisfies only the forward direction; the reverse is a genuine NON-theorem (same structural failure as the Phase-10 x=t arm: liftIdx(totalUnskip) non-injectivity cannot recover non-diagonal-realizable coupled sub-forms).
blockers.why_no_strategic_sorry: Any non-vacuous statement of the faithful converter presupposes the joint-characteristic-type construction; an existential 'exists formula, iff' is vacuous (closed by Classical.choice) and is explicitly forbidden by the plan Postmortem Constraints. The honest artifact is the sorry-free extraction layer + the DIVERGENCE NOTE in NfZoneDepthK.lean.
